这份备份属于其他项目，请先切换到对应项目。: This backup belongs to another project. Switch to that project first.
备份中的 PDF 校验失败。: A PDF in the backup failed verification.
备份中的实验图片校验失败。: An experiment image in the backup failed verification.
原始网页笔记只属于 SC–SNr 项目。: Original web notes belong to the SC–SNr project only.
请选择原网页导出的 JSON 笔记备份。: Choose the JSON notes backup exported by the original web tool.
请明确标注期刊论文或预印本。: Specify whether this is a journal article or a preprint.
请标注实际核对到的证据范围。: Specify the evidence that was actually checked.
请选择 NeuroShelf 每周论文文件，每批最多 50 篇。: Choose a NeuroShelf weekly paper file with up to 50 papers per batch.
所属周应填写该周的周一日期。: Use the Monday date for the week.
请标注检索是否完成。: Specify whether the search is complete.
请记录本次检索来源。: Record the sources searched in this run.
较早发表的补漏论文必须说明日期，不能混作本周新发表。: Explain the dates of older papers found during gap checks. Do not present them as newly published this week.
已入库论文缺少关联记录。: An accepted paper is missing its linked record.
这批候选论文属于另一个项目。: These candidate papers belong to another project.
未找到候选论文，请刷新后重试。: Candidate not found. Refresh and retry.
文献库已达到 10000 篇上限，请先备份整理。: The library has reached its 10,000-paper limit. Back up and organize it first.
这篇论文已在文献库中，请到文献库继续阅读。: This paper is already in your library. Continue reading there.
较少推理，适合希望尽快得到解释时使用。: Less reasoning, for a quicker explanation.
兼顾思考时间与推理深度，适合日常阅读。: Balances response time and reasoning depth for everyday reading.
增加推理，适合分析实验逻辑和证据。: More reasoning to examine experimental logic and evidence.
投入更多推理时间，适合有耐心等待的深入分析。: More thinking time for detailed analysis.
当前连接提供的最高推理档位，通常需要更久。: The highest effort level provided by this connection, usually requiring more time.
选择后自动保存，重启、升级和切换项目后仍然保留。已有笔记和研究资料保持原文。: Saved automatically and kept across restarts, updates and project switches. Existing notes and research content remain in their original language.
译文显示在 AI 侧栏，保留原始导读。: The translation appears in the AI sidebar; the original guide is preserved.
这段原文是什么意思？请先直白解释，再说明关键术语及其在当前论文中的含义；结合提供: What does this passage mean? Explain it in plain language, then clarify key terms and their meaning in this paper. Use the supplied context and distinguish evidence from inference.
PI、关注、详细档案和实验记录随项目资料夹保存。升级后数量不符时，请先核对这里。: PIs, follows, detailed profiles and experiments are stored with the project folder. Check this location if counts differ after an update.
选择含 index.json 的资料夹。软件会验证并记住位置；当前资料夹仍保留。: Choose the folder containing index.json. The app verifies and remembers its location; the current folder is retained.
已保存的项目资料夹无法读取。请检查磁盘或同步状态；现有资料未被覆盖。: The saved project folder is unavailable. Check the drive or sync status; existing data has not been overwritten.
请选择已有 NeuroShelf 项目资料夹，其中应包含 index.json。: Choose an existing NeuroShelf project storage folder containing index.json.
